hints.title: At Most One Zero Window
hints.text: The problem is equivalent to finding the longest subarray containing at most one zero element.

hints.title: Sliding Window Expansion
hints.text: Expand the right pointer. Track the number of zeros encountered in the current window.

hints.title: Left Shrink and Answer
hints.text: When zero count exceeds 1, advance left until zero count is at most 1. The window size minus 1 is the valid length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every deletion and scanning for consecutive 1s takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window advances each pointer at most N times, running in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms the delete-one requirement into a window-with-at-most-one-zero formulation.
complexity.notes: Must delete one element even if array consists entirely of 1s.
